name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should adopt a 2-pixel solid focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity. This provides a clear visual indicator for keyboard navigation, which is essential for users who rely on assistive technologies. By choosing this option, we're accepting a slight trade-off in terms of visual simplicity, as the thicker focus ring may be more noticeable, but it's a worthwhile compromise for the sake of usability. This decision prioritizes accessibility over minimalist design, ensuring that EXCAVA is usable by everyone, including those with visual or motor impairments.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring + 2px glow bleeds at 125% zoom—it’s not just "slightly less precise." At 150% zoom, the glow disappears entirely on high-contrast patterned backgrounds. A 1px ring + 30% glow still risks disappearing on those same backgrounds. Settle it with a 2px ring + 1px outer glow at 15% opacity, tested at 150% zoom on a patterned background.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 2-pixel solid focus ring with a 1-pixel outer glow at 15% opacity. This balances clarity for keyboard users with stability at high zoom and patterned backgrounds. The trade-off is a slightly softer glow, but it remains visible where others fail.
[dispatched 2 workers: worker-2883, worker-1409 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring + 1px glow still risks bleeding at 125% zoom—it’s not just softer, it’s unstable. A 1px solid ring with a 3px outer glow at 10% opacity holds at all zoom levels and patterned backgrounds. Test it at 125%, 150%, and on high-contrast patterns.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 1-pixel solid focus ring with a 3-pixel outer glow at 10% opacity, tested at 125% and 150% zoom and on high-contrast patterned backgrounds. Owner: accessibility-w1.
